crm_notes:
Customer: mid-market product org focused on self-serve SaaS support search + agent assist.
Key ask: better ranking for short queries + reduce incorrect answers surfaced to agents.
POC history: started on Hosted API (embeddings + dot-product baseline), saw modest improvements but hit latency/cost tradeoffs under expected peak. Interested in Redwood rerank endpoint to run model-in-the-loop offline scoring and drive a blended ranker.
Requirements pasted from call: P95 latency target < 80ms for just-in-time rerank at 5–10qps per shard (expect 150 qps total during peak across product), offline scoring batch jobs for nightly re-rank of 100k queries, need EU data residency for a subset of customer data.
Evaluation approach they want: run comparative offline scoring (hosted baseline vs Redwood rerank) using MRR and NDCG@10 + human preference checks on ~2k sampled queries. Also want token-cost estimate for sustained monthly traffic.
Procurement: procurement + legal need dedicated pricing and DPA review. SE requested to provide example offline scoring script and suggested eval pipeline (S3 -> batch rerank -> metrics).
Quotes from product lead: "We need deterministic, auditable rerank scores so product can A/B easily - cost matters but not at expense of surprises."
Notes: suggested next step = 2-week Dedicated POC (small reserved pool) + SE pair-program on offline eval. Ask sales to include a 3-month pilot pricing band and burn-rate calculator in drive link.

offline eval: ingest 100k historic queries, run host baseline + rerank endpoint, compute MRR/NDCG; sample 2k for human review

success criteria: NDCG@10 improvement >= 12% vs baseline AND P95 latency < 80ms; procurement sign-off
